lines: You wake up... and you can *teleport*.
It starts with a sneeze. Achoo! Your bed is gone. You land in the kitchen, face first in your sister's cereal.
You are late for school, so you blink... and land on your desk. In your pyjamas. The whole class stares.
By lunch, you have had breakfast on a beach, a snowball fight on a mountain, and a nap in the desert.
But why is a man with a clipboard... waiting at *every single place* you land?
Follow and comment... for part two!
